name: Individual Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Pick classes from the Cerritos College schedule and take them with college students. You stay enrolled at your regular school and earn college credit.
who_can_apply: K to 12 students who still attend their regular school. You need permission from a parent or guardian and your high school.
pay_detail: The $46 per unit enrollment fee is waived once your form is processed. You must pay a health fee each semester. Other student fees may apply, and you can ask to waive those.
deadline_text: No single deadline is listed. Send a new Dual Enrollment Form for each semester you want to attend.
how_to_apply: Apply to the college. Fill out the Dual Enrollment Form with your class numbers and signatures from you, your parent and your school. Upload it, wait for the clearance email, then enroll. Call (562) 860-2451, ext. 2212.
notes: You do not get priority registration, so have backup classes ready. Partner schools in ABC, Bellflower, Downey and Norwalk-La Mirada Unified also offer classes on campus. Ask your counselor. Zoom drop-in help runs Tuesdays and Wednesdays, 1 to 4 p.m.
